story.title: Story 4: Size Guidance, Retry, And Escalation

result.planSummary: Fixed SV-04-001 by removing production placeholder fallback from semantic lower-band detailed/brief artifact accounting. Semantic accounting now reads only persisted chunk.lowerBand artifacts; placeholder-only lower-band state is rejected or counted as empty, while persisted semantic lowerBand text remains counted. Also updated affected runtime/workbench expectations and hardened the async scheduling test to avoid wall-clock flake while preserving Story 4 retry/escalation behavior and lean artifact storage.

findingsFixed: SV-04-001: production semantic lower-band detailed/brief accounting no longer falls back to chunk.placeholders, and placeholder-only state is covered by tests.
Legacy placeholder-seeded runtime tests were moved to canonical semantic lowerBand fixtures where the behavior under test requires semantic readiness.
A load-sensitive wall-clock assertion in the async lower-band scheduling test was replaced with a deterministic blocked-provider gate.
